_comment: The project's one declaration file. A second file is a second thing to forget.
boundaries: load_vault_with_key — the vault file: ciphertext, then JSON, from disk
parse_text_file — an import file the user picks
fetch_latest_release / download_to — release JSON, the downloaded asset and its signature

deviations.instead: The design document is DESIGN.md at the repository root, not docs/design.md.
deviations.reason: It predates this workflow and is linked from README.md, CLAUDE.md and SECURITY.md. Moving it breaks those links to gain a filename.
docs/file-naming.md fixes this convention and docs/documentation-standards.md lists these paths in its update table. Moving them edits both standards to match a layout neither chose.

deviations.instead: Retroactive specs are docs/specs/<topic>.md, with no roadmap id in the filename.
deviations.reason: They document behaviour extracted from shipped code and serve no single roadmap item, so there is no id to name. docs/specs/README.md states this split; the forward specs do carry an id.
